about: Scenes for the animated video of A Day in the Life of a Product Manager Working with AI Agents. Each scene starts at a phrase in the narration ("at"); keys ending in At name phrases that trigger a move inside the scene. Chapter cards (one per time of day) are added by render.mjs. Numbers are from the article.
